protocol.selection: Maximum worst-language F1, then sum F1, then first ascending threshold; calibration only
protocol.primary: Treatment minus control worst-language overall DEV F1
protocol.uncertainty: 2000 paired video/dialogue-family bootstrap replicates, fixed seed20261108, percentile95CI
protocol.context_window_cache: Treatment calibration predictions may be reused only for identical encoded inputs; per-threshold decisions/metrics audited
